indexingSettings.title: Indexing Settings
indexingSettings.nBandsTooltip: Number of bands (the strongest peaks of the Radon transform) taken from each pattern and used in triplet voting. More bands help weak or multi-phase patterns but add false bands and time. Default 12; PyEBSDIndex itself defaults to 9.
indexingSettings.methodTooltip:
PC optimization algorithm.
Nelder-Mead: local simplex search from the current PC; stops when the fit improves by less than 1e-5.
PSO: particle swarm (30 particles, up to 50 iterations) inside the search limit; slower, less likely to get stuck.
indexingSettings.psoWarn: PSO without GPU is very slow (2-5 min)
indexingSettings.searchLimitTooltip: The optimizer searches PCx, PCy and PCz within +/- this value of the start (fractions of the detector). Used by PSO only; Nelder-Mead ignores it. Default 0.05.
indexingSettings.reflectorsTooltip: Which reflector families Hough indexing uses for each loaded phase. Open a phase to see them, leave some out or add others. The same choice is used by the Indexing page.
indexingSettings.reflectorsNoPhase: Load a phase to choose its reflector families.

pixelwise.title: Pixel-wise PC Correction
pixelwise.modeTooltip:
PC correction mode:
Global: Single PC for entire scan (simplest).
Grid Calibration: Refine PC at grid points and interpolate.
Extrapolate: Fit a plane model from sparse calibration points.
pixelwise.gridStepTooltip:
Spacing between calibration points (in pixels).
Lower = more points (slower but more accurate).
Higher = fewer points (faster but less precise).
pixelwise.autoTooltip: Auto-suggest grid step for ~50 calibration points.
pixelwise.runCalibrationTooltip: Refine PC at each grid point using the selected method.
pixelwise.pcMapTooltip: Show the per-component spatial variation (span) of the fitted PC field
pixelwise.refiningMsg: Refining PC at ~{{count}} grid points (this can take minutes)...
pixelwise.mapActive: A per-pixel PC map is active ({{rows}} × {{cols}} pixels). The PC in use beside the fields is its mean; each pattern is indexed at the PC of its own pixel. If you use numbers you typed, the whole map is moved so that its mean is that PC; the map keeps its shape.
pixelwise.mapActiveFlat: A list of {{count}} PCs without a scan layout is active. The PC in use beside the fields is their mean; each pattern is indexed at the mean.
pixelwise.mapShifted: The PC map was moved so that its mean is the PC you entered. Its shape is unchanged.
pixelwise.mapReplaced: The PC map was replaced by the refined PC: one PC now applies to the whole scan.
pixelwise.doneOtherFile: The calibration finished for '{{dataset}}' after you switched files. Its PC map was stored for '{{dataset}}'; this page does not show it for the file in front of you.

oxford.x: Horizontal position of the pattern centre, as a fraction of the pattern width.
